snippet.title: Bloodspill - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737680/Bloodspill/

Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest! 

Music by Davelton Powers
